notes.title: New game announcement: Castlebound!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce our next big project

[b]Castlebound is a fast-paced action Roguelike with a twist![/b]

[previewyoutube=W2vNQrAlxTc;full][/previewyoutube]
Lead a band of up to 4 heroes in an unique action platforming style and fight hordes of evil monsters!

Game Features

[list]
[*] Fast-Paced Combat: Jump, dodge, and unleash devastating attacks to fend off relentless enemy hordes!
[*] Defend the Walking Castle: Protect your fortress as it moves through dangerous lands!
[*] Solo or Co-Op Action: Take on the challenge alone or team up with a friend for an epic multiplayer adventure!
[*] Multiple Playable Heroes: Fight alongside different warriors, each with unique abilities and playstyles that offer a fresh and dynamic experience!
[*] Roguelike Progression: Each run is unique, unlock new skills, heroes, and upgrades to enhance your chances of survival!
[*] A Unique Take on the Genre: Experience an innovative blend of castle defense and roguelike combat like never before!
[/list]

The battle for the kingdom begins now—will you rise to the challenge?

You can wishlist now
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551820/Castlebound/

Steve
Ogre Pixel
2025

notes.title: New Lonesome Village v1.2 update with more languages and cloud save!
notes.content:
[h1]New Lonesome Village v1.2 update with more languages, cloud save and more![/h1]

We are happy to share that we have a new version 1.2 for Lonesome Village!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711530/d883df2d19804092bc9e8790440af2c3913c3f76.png[/img]

This one has the following new languages:
[list]
[*] Korean
[*] Simplified Chinese
[/list]
This new version also includes [b]cloud save support![/b]

And last but not least, this one also has [b]big improvements in performance and bug fixes![/b]

Thanks again for all the support received, we hope you are enjoying the game!

If you like our game please consider leaving a review, that helps a lot!

Steve
Ogre Pixel
[url=https://ogrepixel.com]www.ogrepixel.com[/url]

notes.title: Lonesome Village v1.1 new update!
notes.content:
Release of Version 1.1 of Lonesome Village on Steam

We are excited to announce that Version 1.1 of Lonesome Village is now available on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711530/cca90c96767c4519d054d65edd47ca10840b2252.png[/img]

This update includes significant improvements:

[list]
[*] Optimized cinematic playback on Steam Deck
[*] Enhancements to the windmill's functionality
[*] Other bug fixes.
[/list]

[h1]A Tiny Sticker Tale Launch Next Week![/h1]

We also want to share that we have a new game coming next week titled [b]A Tiny Sticker Tale[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711530/67c785cfbd86fef8b24744fb07f786fd5ad0513c.png[/img]

It will be launched this October 4th with 10% discount! You can check the Steam page here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2322180/A_Tiny_Sticker_Tale/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2322180/A_Tiny_Sticker_Tale/[/url]


Steve
